severity_fresh_validation.what: 30 reviews the rules were not built on, rated by the product owner for the most serious problem in each review
severity_fresh_validation.model: gpt-oss-20b, impact flags with severity derived by code (prompt v4)
severity_fresh_validation.caution: Only 7 critical cases, so recall has a wide margin of error.

severity_before_after.note: tested on the 27 human-rated critical aspects

severity_before_after.approach: Model reports facts, code derives severity
severity_before_after.note: same 27 aspects; rules were designed after seeing them, so optimistic

extraction_vs_ai_labels.what: 200 dev reviews, first prompt, gpt-oss-120b against labels from a second AI labeler (not human-verified)

labeler_agreement.what: 99 reviews labeled independently by ChatGPT (run by the product owner) and by the pipeline (gpt-oss-20b, prompt v4). Neither is treated as truth.
labeler_agreement.critical: 5 reviews both called critical, 2 only ChatGPT, 4 only the pipeline
labeler_agreement.caution: Most disagreement is short praise such as 'Easy to use' (usable or not). Problem-only agreement was chosen as a view after seeing this. Both labelers are from related model families, which may inflate agreement. 9 of 108 reviews were not run (free daily limit).

evidence.themes: Grouping by word matching plus an AI merge step. The author judged 7 of 10 ranked themes clearly coherent and 3 slightly broad. A formal human check (bar: 85%) is still open.
evidence.release_comparison: Only versions with at least 30 reviews are compared. In this sample three comparisons qualified and none showed a significant rise.
open_items: No human has verified the category and aspect labels, only severity on 70 cases.
Shares are from a random sample of reviews that pass the gate, not every review.
